support_threshold_rationale: Predeclared before any real R2-06 execution, based on sample-count, not observed-result, considerations: MIN_SOURCE_SUPPORT=30 (a source expert's outgoing row must have at least this many total transition observations to be included in headline/strong-transition summaries), MIN_PAIR_SUPPORT=10 (an individual (source, target) cell must have at least this many observations to be reported as a 'strong transition'). Both are conservative, widely-documented minimum-sample-size conventions, not tuned to any R2-06 result -- no real R2-06 canonical run has occurred at the time these constants were fixed. Raw per-cell data is never filtered by this rule; only headline/strong-transition SUMMARIES are.
transition_unit_definition: One counted transition observation = one (source_expert_id, target_expert_id) pair contributed by one pair of CONSECUTIVE entries yielded by Trace.token_selections(layer, phase) for one layer (token-to-token, SAME layer; 'consecutive' = consecutive in the iterator's own yielded order, not consecutive token_index). Multi-expert selections are expanded via pairwise set-to-set counting: every expert i in the source selection paired with every expert j in the target selection, each pair counted once with weight 1 (never deduplicated). Cross-layer transitions are excluded from this unit entirely; layer visitation order is architectural, not a routing-structure transition.
